_comment: Tech-sleeve basket definition for the weekly outlook model.
PUBLIC FILE. Tickers and percentage weights ONLY.
Never add dollar balances, share counts, cost basis, or account numbers.
Those belong in private/holdings.json, which is gitignored. See
docs/PORTFOLIO-SCHEMA.md for the full data contract.
notes: status=PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE means these constituents are a generic
large-cap US technology reference basket, NOT the owner's holdings.
portfolio_track.py refuses to publish an owner-attributed call while
owner_confirmed is false -- it publishes the call labelled REFERENCE
BASKET instead. Replace constituents from the uploaded JPMorgan
statement, set owner_confirmed=true, set source and as_of, then rerun.
Weights are placeholders and are deliberately equal: no weighting claim
is being made about the owner's actual allocation.

_comment: Cadence only -- no dollar amount. The projection tab renders a
normalized index (base 100), so it needs the RHYTHM of contributions,
not their size. Dollar amounts live in private/holdings.json and
appear only in the owner-only email.
